name: Spiders Play with their Food
strategy:
PRIMARY STRATEGY: Spiders Typal + Food (Deathtouch Engine)

Two pillars, mechanically welded together by the commander:
1. SPIDERS — Shelob grants every Spider deathtouch + ward {2}, AND Spiders are the FOOD ENGINE: Shelob only makes Food when a creature dies from damage dealt by a SPIDER you control. So a Spider (Shelob counts) must land the killing blow. More Spiders = more deathtouch removal AND more Food. Keep Spiders alive — they are the engine.
2. FOOD — When a Spider's (deathtouch) damage kills a creature, Shelob creates a token copy of it that is a FOOD ARTIFACT and loses all other card types. IMPORTANT: the token is NOT a creature — it can't attack or block, and it CANNOT be sacrificed to creature-sacrifice outlets. It's an artifact you sac for life, feed to Food-matters / artifact-matters / Food-sac payoffs, and it denies opponents their dead creatures.

Engine: a Spider deals deathtouch damage → the creature dies → Shelob makes a Food-artifact copy.

GAME PLAN: Deploy Spiders, aim their deathtouch (combat + fight/bite spells + pinging equipment, all SOURCED FROM A SPIDER) at opposing creatures for one-sided removal, and bank the Food artifacts. Grow a Food/artifact economy (ramp, drain, artifact-matters, Food payoffs) while the Spider board snowballs.

KEY LINES:
• Deathtouch Spider (or Shelob) + fight/bite spell = destroy any creature → Shelob Food copy
• Lure on Shelob = the whole board must block her → mass deathtouch kills → mass Food
• Pinging equipment (Viridian Longbow / Thornbite Staff) on a SPIDER = repeatable deathtouch pings → repeatable Food
• Food payoffs: sac Food for life/value, drain per artifact, artifact-matters synergies
• Token doublers (Parallel Lives) multiply the Food artifacts

WANTS:
• Spiders and Spider tribal support — they are BOTH the board and the Food engine (anthems, cost reducers, tutors)
• Ways to give non-Spiders 'is a Spider' or to route deathtouch damage through a Spider
• Deathtouch enablers and fight/bite spells (damage dealt BY a Spider)
• Pinging / repeatable damage attached to Spiders
• Food generators AND Food/artifact payoffs (sac-Food, artifact-matters, drain, ramp off Food)
• Token doublers
• Removal that DESTROYS (not exile) so bodies die for the engine

DOES NOT WANT:
• Cards that exile instead of destroy (no death = no Food)
• Creature-sacrifice outlets that expect to eat Food — Food are ARTIFACTS, not creatures
• Plans that sacrifice your own Spiders — they're the engine, keep them alive
• Non-deathtouch, non-Spider, non-Food filler with no synergy
